description: Use for a rule-based risk label on an ERC-20 token before you accept or route it: OFAC SDN match, upgradeable proxy, owner with mint/pause/blacklist (USDC, USDT, WBTC, cbBTC issuer-listed). Returns the paid x402 request for your input (GET /token/risk, $0.01 per call; schema linked). Call that URL with an x402 or MPP client to get the data. Bad input is refused before any charge. For a wallet (not a token contract) use wallet_risk. With an access key (Authorization: Bearer p0k_..., buy at https://x402-bazaar-rank.x402-bazaar-rank-worker.workers.dev/keys/buy?usd=5) the tool pays the call itself, returns the data and deducts the price. First call each day returns the data itself, free; later calls return the paid request.
